data.name: Kristian
data.gender_notes: Kristian is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from 'Christos', Greek for 'Anointed One'. In Christian tradition, the name Kristian signifies a follower and believer in Jesus Christ. The name Kristian carries the meaning “Follower of Christ” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Kristian usually hope their child will grow to embody follower of christ and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Kristian belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Follower of Christ.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kristian total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_hebrew.name: כריסטיאן
in_hebrew.meaning: צאצא של נוצרי, נצרי, בן האל, שליח
in_hebrew.long_meaning: כריסטיאן היא הצורה העברית של השם הנוצרי, והיא נובעת מהמילה היוונית 'Christos' (Χριστός) אשר פירושה 'משוח', 'בן האל', 'שליח'. השם Kristian נהוג בעברית בצפון אפריקה ובאירופה המערבית, והוא עשוי לשמש כיחידה או כשם משפחה. בעברית, Kristian נובעת גם מהאיות הלטיני 'Christianus', אשר הוא שם נוצרי הנובע מהמילה 'Christ' (Christus) ו'ans' (anus), 'עובד', 'אדם'.

in_greek.name: Χριστιανός
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Χριστιανός είναι η ελληνική μορφή του ονόματος, και προέρχεται από τη λέξη Χριστός (Χριστός), που σημαίνει 'χριστός', 'απεσταλμένος', 'βίος'. Ο Χριστιανός είναι το όνομα της μορφής που προέκυψε από την ένωση του ονόματος του Χριστού με το επίθετο 'ανός', που σημαίνει 'άνθρωπος', 'απεσταλμένος'.

in_latin.name: Christianus
in_latin.long_meaning: Christianus est nomen Christianum quod a Christiano derivatur. Christianus est nomen quod ad Christianum pertinet, qui est a Christo derivatus. Christianus est nomen quod significat 'filius Dei', 'servus Christi', 'missionarius'.

in_english.name: Kristian
in_english.meaning: Christian, follower of Christ, son of God, servant of God
in_english.long_meaning: Kristian is a name that originates from the Greek word 'Christos' meaning 'Christ', 'Messiah', or 'the anointed one'. It is derived from the Latin name 'Christianus' which means 'follower of Christ', 'son of God', 'servant of God'. The name Kristian is often used in Scandinavian countries and is associated with Christian values and principles. It is also a name that signifies a strong connection to faith and spirituality.

historical_references.reference: The term 'Kristian' appears in Old Norse sagas to denote a Christian man. This usage can be traced back to the 12th century when Norse society was undergoing Christianization.

The name 'Kristian' also appears in Slavic languages as 'Christian' or 'Khristian'. It is derived from the Greek word 'Christos' meaning 'anointed one'. This usage became popular during the spread of Christianity among the Slavic peoples in the late 9th and early 10th centuries.
